title: Steps 1–2: no way into admin from the home page; it hides behind your name, then the profile page
where: / (site header) and /me, 1440×900, signed in as admin
what_happens: The home page is the participant directory with no admin or 'New session' link. The only way in is the name chip at the top right (it doesn't look like a menu), which opens the participant profile, where 'Manage your sessions' and 'Create a new session' sit as small mono-caps pills next to Log out. That's 2 extra screens and a guess before admin starts.
who_hurts: An admin starting the main path from the front door: they have to know that their name leads to admin; a new organizer may not find it at all.
suggested_fix: For organizers, add a quiet 'Admin' (or 'Sessions') link in the site header beside the name chip (site-header.tsx already loads the user; requireOrganizer gives the role).
rule: project user path: Start a session starts with 'Open admin'; keep the trip short
step: 1: open admin from the home page
